clue.text: Address for beloved skipper, one probably in his 60s

parts.note: baby is a pet name used when speaking to a lover
a boomer is a male kangaroo, an animal that skips along

explanation.surface: A sailor's sweetheart calls the ship's captain darling, though he is probably in his sixties.

explanation.definitionFit: The post-war birth bulge produced a generation who were around sixty when this puzzle appeared.
